retrieval_relevance.blocker_detail: Full 5.23M Wikipedia (HotpotQA) and 8.84M passage collection (MS MARCO) archives not present locally.

g1_prompt_injection.reason: Canonical benchmark datasets (RAGTruth, HaluEval, HotpotQA, MS MARCO) do not contain adversarial prompt-injection attack vectors or ground-truth injection labels. TrustRAG strictly refuses to fabricate attack labels.

g2_poisoning_detection.reason: Canonical benchmark datasets do not contain knowledge-poisoning attack metadata or poisoned passage labels. Dedicated security benchmarks (RSB arXiv:2505.18543) remain pending public distribution.
